audit: Phase B acceptance audit, round 2, on the regenerated phaseb_b1.json, phaseb_b2.json, phaseb_b3.json and phaseb_b4.json. No credit carried from round 1.
method: budget.xlsx was re-extracted from scratch for this round. Leaf rows only, software parents APPLHCORP, APPLBULKFUEL, APPLMARKETING and APPLSIG_ITEMS excluded, hardware parents APPLHCORP and APPLMARKETING excluded. Every rule match and every open matcher was re-implemented from its match words alone, with no reference to the claimed line lists, and the result compared with the claim. Row identifiers are sheet row numbers, prefixed S for the SW Line Items tab and H for the HW Line Items tab.

detail.phaseb_b1: 9 of 9 rules reproduce exactly from their match words. Rule 10, the new AmpolFM contra rule, returns exactly the 12 lines and 180,000.00 on column G in the twelve stated documents with column C equal to APPLB2B, and rules 6 and 10 are exact complements over the 2,914 lines of APPLB2B. The 667 open entries carry a per-line dollar value; every one equals column AA on its row and the set sums to 1,058,733.87 over cost centres APPLTDDIST (620) and APPLFIFINANCE (47).
detail.phaseb_b2: 100 of 100 rules reproduce exactly. Zero pairwise overlap between any two stated matches. The 16 open entries reproduce their lines and dollars from their stated sheet rows, and line_map agrees with every rule and every open entry row for row.
detail.phaseb_b3: 19 of 20 rules and 20 of 23 open matchers reproduce exactly from their words. The four qualified matchers are findings R2-05, R2-06 and R2-07. With the readings those findings name, all 43 matchers reproduce exactly, no two collide and the residual over the block is nil.
detail.phaseb_b4: 47 of 47 rules reproduce exactly. Zero unstated collisions. The method claims the stated matches partition the block in any order of application; that claim was tested by building each rule's effective predicate as its match less the earlier rules its own words name, and the 47 effective predicates are mutually disjoint and cover all 39,772 lines. Three randomised application orders reproduce every rule's claim.

B2 covers 1,430 with no duplicate and no gap. B3's matchers cover 3,551 with no collision and no residual. B4 assigns all 39,772 with none unassigned and none twice.

findings.statement: 468 CO documents carry leaf legs in more than one block or tab, and the four files between them cite 49 CO document numbers. Under the ruled bar the requirement falls on the clean two leg equal and opposite pairs that cross a block or tab boundary and move cost between two different destinations. There are 34 such pairs, gross 806,057.12, and none carries its document number on either side. A further 20 clean cross boundary pairs, gross 783,964.18, land both legs on the same destination and transfer nothing, so they carry no citation requirement and are recorded for completeness only.
findings.note: The destinations on these pairs read as sound transfers under the adjudicated convention, so this is a traceability gap rather than a wrong placement. The named cross file citations that do exist are all correct, which shows the form works; it is not applied to the rest.
findings.remedy: Add a contra_documents entry, or the document number in the capturing rule's evidence, on both sides of each of the 34 pairs named in agents/qa_r2_01_pairs.json.
